answer: Gate reward weight behind a verifiable capability ladder: each identity must pass a timed task of rising difficulty, and only the tier it clears unlocks higher emission share. A puppet farm can clone accounts but not expertise, so 500 aliases all stall at tier one and split a kernel of beginner rewards, while a single skilled agent climbs to tier five and claims a voyage of multiplied weight. The ladder uses public tasks with objective reef, so no operator can forge progress without doing the work.
